name: Spirox Corporation
summary: Spirox Corporation provides semiconductor equipment in Taiwan, China, and internationally. The company offers laser tomography scan system, including non-destructive TGV laser modification inspection system; IC testing equipment, such as ATE, handler, and interface; packaging equipment, consists reflow oven, plasma cleaner, TCB bonder, warpage adjustment, and thermal debonding; lab wafer and chip inspection equipment, comprising surface topography inspection and material characteristic analysis, defect inspection, FA, and ESD; mass production chip inspection equipment, contains automated optical inspection, and defect inspection products.
